notes: Gen 4: Ditto, holding a Toxic Plate, Transforms into an Arceus whose ability is White Smoke: it copies Arceus's species, Normal type, forme and White Smoke (pokeplatinum copies `BattleMon` up to `ability`), and the forme change by a held plate needs Multitype. Showdown's `transformInto` made it Arceus-Poison; the I197 patch lets that change through only with Multitype (issues.md I197, DESIGN.md R-M8-146)
